housing.summary: Numbeo data for Borås (Jun 2026) did not include a 1-bedroom city-centre rent figure (listed as unknown). Outside city-centre 1-BR was approximately 8,700 SEK/month. Based on regional averages for a mid-sized Swedish city, 1-BR city-centre rent is likely in the 7,000–9,000 SEK range. Main rental portals are blocket.se (now qasa.se) and hemnet.se.

banking.summary: Major Swedish banks in Borås include Swedbank, Handelsbanken, SEB, and Nordea. Borås is the fifth-largest city in Västra Götaland. To open an account newcomers need: valid passport or national ID, Swedish personnummer or samordningsnummer, proof of address, and sometimes proof of employment or income.
required_docs: Proof of employment or income (some banks)

schools.summary: Borås is in Västra Götaland County. International school or IB-curriculum options within Borås itself are limited; the broader Gothenburg region (40 km away) has more extensive international schools. The Swedish national school directory (Skolverket) lists available schools. Västtrafik's Borås Mini periodbiljett is available for local transit.
curricula: IB (International Baccalaureate) available in Gothenburg region, approx. 40 km from Borås

legal_admin.summary: All persons moving to Sweden must register with Skatteverket via Folkbokföring (population registration) within 3 months. In Borås, this is done at a local Skatteverket service office. Required to receive a personnummer and access public services.

tax_finance.summary: Personnummer is assigned by Skatteverket upon Folkbokföring. It is a 10-digit personal identity number essential for banking, healthcare, employment, and tax matters in Sweden.

transport.summary: Public transport in Borås is operated by Västtrafik (the regional transit authority for Västra Götaland, website: vasttrafik.se). Västtrafik offers a Borås Mini periodbiljett (local Borås zone). Per Numbeo, monthly pass costs approximately 771 SEK (Jun 2026). EU/EEA driving licences are valid indefinitely in Sweden; non-EU licences valid 1 year after residency then must be exchanged. Healthcare via Västra Götalandsregionen vårdcentral.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EEA licences remain valid in Sweden indefinitely. Non-EU licences valid for 1 year from registration; thereafter exchange required via Transportstyrelsen.
transport.healthcare_registration: Register with a Västra Götalandsregionen vårdcentral (primary care centre) at 1177.se
